Problem Statement:
After deleting the  old login system for his web portal , Kumar designs a new login system. This time he must implement a password suggester for new users. If the new user prefers a password that already exists in the system , he/she must be suggested the lexicographically smallest password greater than the preferred password For example say the user wants to have his/her password as "guvigeektech" . If the password is already present the system must suggest "guvigeektech1" . If the user's preferred password is not present in the system , they can be assigned that passoword as it is. Help Kumar implement this system . The requests must be processed in order. i.e when you answer a request for a user , you must consider the passwords suggested to the previous users having already been present in the system. Note: The new password must always be lexicographically smallest. for example: if the password "abcd1" is present in the system. The user should be suggested "abcd2" and not "abcd11"
input_spec: The first line will contain a single integer N denoting the number of words already present in the system. The next N lines will contain a single string each : no two of these N strings will be the same : they are all unique passwords in the system The next line will contain a single integer Q denoting the number of times the system will have to accept a password and suggest one. The next Q lines will contain a single string each denoting the user requests for passwords
output_spec: Your output must consist of Q lines: each line the suggested password for a user's request
